title: Snake Arena
description: Dominate the neon multiplayer arena! Slither, consume glowing energy orbs, boost to outmaneuver rivals, and collect fallen mass to grow into the ultimate serpent.
instructions: Navigate your snake towards glowing energy orbs to grow longer and score points.
Trap other snakes so their heads crash into your body.
Collect the energy particles released by destroyed snakes to rapidly increase your size.
Compete on the live arena leaderboard for #1 Champion rank.
controls: Space / Left Click / Tap Boost: Speed boost (consumes energy)
